author: Murphh
body:
Yesterday when I was playing walls, one whole board only had "jungle" maps available for play.  There were 8 games open with zero players all for "jungle". I didn't want to play jungle.  I wanted to play the new maps, so I didn't join and waited for a map that I like to appear.

Is there a way to have the map rotation move onto the next map after 5 or 10 minutes if no one is playing it (zero players)?

If that is difficult for all maps, maybe only one map on the board that does this.
Thanks for listening. :)
